varparent.set.tooltip: Gives the object the variable parent with the ID in the field; an empty field takes it away.
varparent.pick.tooltip: Click the object in the map that becomes the variable parent. Esc stops. Attached objects and rows of objects can be given by their ID.
varparent.show.tooltip: Selects the parent in the map.
varparent.hint: The element whose data this one shows or runs. A traffic light names its crossing here (its first label is the number of the light), a departure display its bus stop. The parent must lie in this tile or in a tile next to it.
varparent.target.missing: #{id}, which is not in this tile or next to it
varparent.status.bad_id: Type the ID of the parent as a whole number, or leave the field empty to take it away.
varparent.status.pick: Click the object that becomes the variable parent of {element}. Esc stops.
varparent.status.stays: The variable parent stays as it is.
varparent.status.failed: The variable parent could not be changed ({element}): {reason}
varparent.done.set: The variable parent of {element} is #{parent} now
varparent.done.removed: The variable parent of {element} is taken away
varparent.same: The variable parent of {element} is the same.
